title: Scoped proof: four fully occupied swaps require twelve calls
body:
Four coordinate-SWAP targets on exactly four roles require **twelve paid coordinate-CNOT calls** in the formal `F2[GL_2(F2)]` rank-one-idempotent register model, even with free scalar `GL_4(F2)` mixing. This closes the four-role balanced ten-call residual left by #1722 and investigated in #1755. All inputs are arbitrary; no extra dirty workspace is included in this minimum.

The new argument is short: at full occupancy `T=[s]I`, conjugating a paid call by `T` flips a↔b while retaining its scalar projector. A twisted cyclic rotation therefore converts a hypothetical `(5,5)` word into `(4,6)` or `(6,4)`, which the credited #1722 saturation theorem excludes. The README restates saturation with credit and retains its exact proof bytes. The same cut argument shows that any full-occupancy saving below `3t` needs at least `2t+3` calls; equality forces alternating labels.

A concrete four-active/one-dirty counterexample shows why partial-target conjugation leaves the paid alphabet. **Ten calls with active/dirty coupling on five or six roles remain open.** No supplier, selected-frontier, physical hosting or kappa change is claimed.

Only `research/four-swap-full-occupancy/` is added. It contains the proof, task and source pins, exact formal replay, a separately written faithful regular-operator checker, deterministic receipt and failure controls. Both implementations were written by the same assisted author; no independent human or Lean review is claimed. The preliminary SAT work led to the analytic proof and is not a replay dependency.

Validation on Python 3.12.12/macOS arm64:

- Registered replay passes: `python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/four-swap-full-occupancy`.
- Both engines agree on 5,334 conjugations, 24 positive words, 288 chronological cuts, 264 omitted-call controls, 99,861 label patterns and the 992-factor partial-target boundary.
- Five test groups pass, including corrupt source/receipt rejection, natural-representation alias detection and optimized read-only relocation.
- `make selected-record-check` and whitespace checks pass. Full selected cold replay, physical/compiler/hosting/precision/analytic admission and proof-assistant verification were not run or claimed.

Exact base: `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`. Exact predecessor heads and refreshed overlap coverage are in TASK.json. [Claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1317#discussioncomment-18919990).

Credit commdata2338 (#1414/#1491), Gareth Davidson (#1333), Cinna Davis (#1541), Ross Richardson (#1722), and Aaron Wang (#1705/#1755). Prepared for Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
